summary: Implemented the issue #201 refactor: plain, ignite-free savers plus thin ignite handlers. Changes: new monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver) and monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver); new plot_2d_or_3d_image in monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py, used by TensorBoardImageHandler; SegmentationSaver and ClassificationSaver now delegate to the new savers with unchanged constructors; new tests test_nifti_saver.py, test_csv_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py; docs/source/data.rst updated. Behaviour changes: NiftiSaver now honours dtype (default float32), and the 3D plotting path plots all channels up to max_channels instead of only the first. Nothing was run, per instructions; the tests are unverified. No commits made.
